 Former 007 Pierce Brosnan Gushes With Excitement For “Visionary” Director Denis Villeneuve Tackling ‘Bond 26’: “We Are Going To Be Blown Away”
 By Christopher Marc 
 November 3, 2026 12:57 pm 
 0 
 248 
 Facebook X Pinterest WhatsApp 
 We’re all thrilled to see what Amazon MGM Studios comes up with when it comes to “ Bond 26 ,” as they’re currently gearing up the casting of the next James Bond (actors Callum Turner and Jack Lowden said to have done on-camera testing last month). So while we’re likely going to get some jaded comments from Daniel Craig , who is likely sick of fielding Bond questions for the last 20 years, Pierce Brosnan seems all too happy to be an audience member for this next stage, sharing his opinion on the next film. 
 When asked by Vanity Fair this week about his thoughts on what the next actor is getting themselves into, Brosnan was quick to endorse hopeful Callum Turner . 
 READ MORE: November Movie Preview: ‘Wild Horse Nine,’ ‘Paper Tiger,’ ‘Cliff Booth,’ ‘Sunrise On The Reaping’ & More 
 “Oh, I’m just an audience member now. I’m just the man in the street who is eager to see who is going to play this epic role of cinematic history. All the men who are on the list now are actors I admire. Callum, Callum Turner, is someone I’ve worked with, and he’s so strong. They all have a voice, a physique, and a presence on film. They all have longevity as actors, all of these young men.”
 He also gushed about director Denis Villeneuve being at the helm of the next chapter of the James Bond franchise (said to be a one-and-done effort from the French-Canadian filmmaker). 
 “I think we are going to be blown away. I really do. [Villeneuve] is such an iconoclastic director. His work is visionary, and his stealth and imagination of camera work and storytelling is so visceral and sensuous. It’s going to be great. It’s going to be truly magnificent. Of course, we all get sentimental and nostalgic, and you have to give it time and be patient, and it’s always such a delightful game. But Villeneuve is someone who I have great admiration for, and I look forward to seeing the work,” the former James Bond actor told VF in a recent profile interview.

 While Brosnan was well-received during his tenure, sadly his sequels never really lived up to the quality of “ GoldenEye ” despite the heaps of money and effort put into them (there is still plenty to enjoy from those uneven installments). That said, we’re still waiting for an official announcement from Amazon/producers about who has been selected as Villeneuve’s James Bond, as that news is just around the corner.
